paper.title: The Clock and the Pizza: Two Stories in Mechanistic Explanation of Neural Networks

protocol.input_order: All (a,b) pairs: a=0..58 outer, b=0..58 inner; last-token logits, classes c=0..58.
protocol.attention: Unmasked alpha*softmax(QK^T/sqrt(32))+(1-alpha)*J, where J is all ones. The stored triangular mask is unused.
protocol.architecture: Token plus learned position embeddings; one attention residual; one 512-wide biased ReLU MLP residual; unembedding. No normalization.
protocol.pca: Center [59,128] token embeddings; full SVD; retain 20 components. Selected-coordinate reconstructions include the original mean.
protocol.fve: Standardize each full [59,59,59] tensor independently to mean 0 and population std 1; FVE=1-population_variance(observed-predicted). No fitting.
protocol.training: No retraining. Published training configurations report 20,000 epochs and 80% training data. Original seeds and split membership are unpublished; evaluate all 3,481 pairs.
caveats: The notebook's alternative ob expression differs from the paper's Pizza equation; Table 2 is compared against the paper equation.
The paper has inconsistent first-six-PC accuracy claims (91.4% versus 99.7%); report the observed accuracy descriptively, without selecting a target.
The circle frequencies and Table 2 comparisons concern Pizza Model A; Clock Model B supplies the baseline distance-irrelevance control.
